item.tib: o rgyan rgyal tshab bstan gnyis gling pa yi skyes rab rnam thar gter 'byung lo rgyus bcas rdo rje rin phreng ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba glegs bam gnyis pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni/ lho tsha ba rong nas/ shar rgyal mo rong du 'gro ba'i dus bstan pa'i tshe/ zha mo mthong ba don ldan gyis lung bstan byung tshul ste le'u bco brgyad pa'o//
